messages:
maria: Heads up — we're scheduling a rollout of a tightened seccomp + ptrace sandbox policy for the base image refresh this Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC. A few sidecars that rely on ptrace (profilers, some legacy debuggers) will fail. Need RBAC sign-off for the deployers and an audit-log plan.

jordan: thanks — can you drop the list of affected services?

maria: short list: profiler-sidecar, dev-trace-agent, legacy-probe. I'll attach the mapping in the canary note.

lee: fyi ptrace calls are used by the dev-trace-agent for live sampling. If we block it, they need a non-ptrace path or a capability flag.

maria: agreed. plan: canary in staging -> limited prod canary 5% -> auto-rollback if any 5xx or crashloop >=3 in 10m.

sre-oncall: add me to the canary watches. what RBAC changes do you need?

maria: need to grant the image-refresh role to the build-team CI service account and restrict the old deploy role that could bypass signing. Proposed policy: `roles/image-refresher` w/ `kms:Sign` and `images:promote` only. remove `images:admin` from team-ci.

jordan: can you paste the proposed IAM binding here?

maria: ```
// proposed binding
principal: serviceAccount:ci@redwood-inference
role: roles/image-refresher
conditions: { tag == "base-refresh" }
```

lee: looks good. small ask: add `audit-log:write` permission to the role so we can ensure the signing event is captured in telemetry.

maria: good call, adding that. Also enabling structured audit fields: `image.old_digest`, `image.new_digest`, `signer_kms_key`.

sre-oncall: how are we exporting those structured fields? logship or CloudAudit?

maria: we'll emit to CloudAudit with JSON payload and also forward to our SIEM (logship rule id: ls-8812).

deploy-bot: canary triggered for base-image v2026.03-c (staging) — 8 nodes.

jordan: quick vuln triage note — if the canary fails due to seccomp violation we'll see `EPERM` logs from kernel. pls capture a pod dump with `kubectl describe` + `kubectl logs -c sidecar`.

lee: added a small wrapper to fallback: if ptrace fails, the agent will start a no-attach sampling mode (lower fidelity). We can enable via feature flag `TRACE_FALLBACK=true` pushed during canary.

maria: perfect. action items: 1) jordan to approve RBAC binding, 2) lee to push fallback flag to canary images, 3) sre-oncall to watch metrics dashboard + enable auto-rollback, 4) infra to whitelist KMS key for ci service account.

jordan: RBAC binding approved. quick note: ensure KMS binding doesn't grant decrypt to CI - only sign.

sre-oncall: dashboards set, alerts: "base-image-canary-crashloop" and "sidecar-seccomp-errors" created. Will post pager if >5 nodes unhealthy in 10m. :rotating_light: 

maria: rolling canary to 25% in prod in 30m if no regressions. I'll post a final runbook snippet here after we cutover.

lee: oncall please hold off rollback for the first 10m unless crashloops >3 per node; some apps take a bit to adapt.

sre-oncall: noted — will follow the runbook thresholds.

maria: runbook snippet: ```
If canary fails:
1) set feature flag `TRACE_FALLBACK=true` globally for affected deployments
2) revert seccomp profile to previous policy via k8s configmap `seccomp-profiles/base-old`
3) revoke `roles/image-refresher` from CI until fix merged
4) open incident: #inc-runtime-seccomp
```

jordan: one more compliance ask: security wants an attestation record for the base image signing event (who triggered, SHA, KMS key). Ensure the audit payload is archived for 365 days.

maria: will update retention policy on the SIEM.

deploy-bot: prod canary ramped to 25% (tokens: 200/800). No errors reported in first 12m.

lee: looks green on sidecars in canary. I'm going to start the staged rollout.

maria: thanks team. I'll follow up with the final postmortem and the attestation export. :thumbsup:
